replies.author: Graffeine
replies.text: UpFourAGoodTime seems like if you run a 5G hotspot device and connect your phone to it via wired tether instead of via WiFi, its much more private. At least if I am reading that right.

replies.author: UpFourAGoodTime
replies.text:
Graffeine

Based on the logic from the Twitter post: Compared to having a Wi-Fi hotspot running on cell service, yes. It's not that much of a meaningful difference compared to using cell service on your main phone, though.

The device you use for tethering still has it's own unique identifiers.

Most people shouldn't bother.
